discoveryMethod: Separate official English and Amharic discovery routes, followed by direct HTTPS inspection of the public e-Land landing page, current JavaScript bundle, and Ethio-NSDI host.
queryOutcomes: The e-Land landing page returned HTTP 200 and its current bundle identifies the Land Holding Registration and Information Agency and city-specific e-services, but no anonymous Bule Hora parcel layer was evidenced. Ethio-NSDI did not pass normal TLS verification because the host presented a self-signed certificate; no certificate exception was used.
